# GENERATED by TestReachableEmissionArtifactIsRegenerated. DO NOT EDIT BY
# HAND: the test regenerates this file and fails on any difference.
#
# What each provider EMITS, collected by walking the call graph from its own
# methods through every package-local function it reaches, to any depth, and
# recording every statically resolvable key written into anything of the
# fact-field map type. Matched by TYPE, so a local, a parameter, a struct
# field and a returned map are one case rather than four.
#
# THE RESIDUAL, NAMED. Three things this walk does not reach:
#   1. a key that is not statically determined -- built from a variable, a
#      format string, or a value read from a row. COUNTED, per provider, in
#      the dynamic_key_sites column. A zero there is an OBSERVED zero, and a
#      provider that grows a dynamic key shows up as a diff in this file.
#   2. a helper in ANOTHER package that writes into a map passed to it.
#   3. reflection.
# 2 and 3 are not counted, because a count of them would be a count of what
# this walk cannot see at all. They are the honest edge of the instrument.
#
# reached_funcs is how many package-local functions the walk visited from
# that provider's methods -- the walk reporting its own reach, so a collapse
# in coverage is visible here rather than showing up as a provider that
# quietly emits less.
#
# fact kind / reached_funcs / dynamic_key_sites / emitted field keys
